regions.title: confmap — configuration mapping
regions.narrative: confmap owns how collector YAML becomes typed Go configuration: components receive a resolved confmap rather than raw bytes. Providers under confmap/provider teach the resolver new URI schemes — `s3://`, `aes://`, Google Secret Manager, AWS Secrets Manager — so a single config file can be assembled from remote sources at startup.

regions.title: internal — repository-private packages
regions.narrative: internal/ holds Go packages shared only inside this repository. pkg/README.md states the rule: if a module is used solely by contrib components it belongs here, to keep the public API footprint small. coreinternal, sharedcomponent, tidylist and the per-vendor helpers all follow that rule.

regions.title: pkg — shared public modules
regions.narrative: pkg/ contains Go modules meant for external consumption: ottl, the transformation language behind the transform processor; stanza, the log parsing pipeline; golden and pdatatest helpers; sampling and translation utilities. The folder README warns that these are public API, so breaking changes follow the core contribution guidelines.

regions.title: cmd — binaries and generators
regions.narrative: cmd/ is where binaries are assembled: otelcontribcol (the contrib distribution), oteltestbedcol, telemetrygen, opampsupervisor, plus the codecovgen and githubgen generators. Which components each binary contains is declared in builder-config.yaml, which is why a new component is not shipped until it is added there.

regions.title: config — shared configuration packages
regions.narrative: config/ holds configuration packages that components import instead of reimplementing — today configdbauth, the database authentication options shared by SQL-backed components. It is the place to look when several components need the same auth, TLS or credential structure.

regions.title: testbed — end-to-end and load harness
regions.narrative: testbed/ measures the collector rather than unit-testing it: a load generator produces telemetry, the collector under test processes it, and a mock backend receives and asserts on the results. Its correctness, stability and load suites are what the e2e and stability make targets drive.

regions.title: docs — contributor documentation
regions.narrative: docs/ is the contributor's manual. new-components.md walks through donating a component — sponsor, at least three code owners, metadata.yaml, the generator commands and the three-PR sequence (structure, implementation, Alpha) — testing.md covers build tags, release.md the release process, and templates.md holds ready-made PR text.

regions.title: .chloggen — changelog staging area
regions.narrative: .chloggen is where the changelog is written. Every user-facing change lands as one YAML entry created from TEMPLATE.yaml, validated by `make chlog-validate`, and folded into CHANGELOG.md (for users) or CHANGELOG-API.md (for package consumers) at release time before the entries are deleted.
